page_title: BOU 0-0 CHE | Bournemouth v Chelsea 06/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+1' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) kept talking out of turn to the referee until Michael Oliver lost patience and pulled out a yellow card.
90+1' Reece James (Chelsea) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Michael Oliver blows for a foul.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
89' Close! Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) unleashes a rocket of a shot from the edge of the box and his shot flies just a few inches over the crossbar.
87' Here's the change. Evanilson leaves the pitch and Enes Unal (Bournemouth) comes on as a substitute.
85' Michael Oliver shows a yellow card to Marc Guiu (Chelsea) for a tough tackle.
84' James Hill (Bournemouth) commits a rough challenge and Michael Oliver blows his whistle for a foul.
83' Joao Pedro (Chelsea) tries to find Pedro Neto, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
80' The resulting corner, taken by Alex Scott (Bournemouth), comes to nothing.
80' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) is the one to unleash a good effort towards the left side of the goal. His shot, however, is saved by the goalkeeper. What a save!
77' Today's match ends for Alejandro Garnacho who will be replaced by Estêvão (Chelsea).
76' Alejandro Garnacho (Chelsea) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
74' Andoni Iraola has decided to substitute Alejandro Jimenez and he is replaced by Amine Adli (Bournemouth).
74' We are about to witness a substitution. David Brooks (Bournemouth) is replacing Justin Kluivert.
73' Ball possession – 40:60.
72' Ooh that was close! Alejandro Garnacho (Chelsea) collects a pass and runs with pace goalwards before unleashing a great drive from the edge of the box, but it goes inches wide of the right post.
70' Reece James (Chelsea) quickly takes the free kick with a short pass.
69' Michael Oliver has a clear sight and sees a foul from Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth).
66' Marc Guiu (Chelsea) squandered a huge opportunity from inside the 6-yard box. He blazed it high over the bar.
65' The attendance for today's match is 11240.
62' Problems for Andoni Iraola as Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and James Hill replaces him.
61' It's a nice effort by Marc Guiu (Chelsea) from the edge of the box, but it's low towards the middle of the goal and straight down the throat of Djordje Petrovic. Easy save.
58' Substitution. Joao Pedro (Chelsea) has come on for Cole Palmer.
57' Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
57' Dangerous play by Wesley Fofana (Chelsea). Michael Oliver blows his whistle for a foul.
55' A corner kick by Bournemouth is thwarted by the well prepared Robert Sanchez (Chelsea).
55' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
54' The number of shots on goal at present is 4:3.
53' A pass by Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
52' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) produces a good strike that sails to the middle of the goal, but his low effort ends up in the goalkeeper's gloves.
52' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) produces a good strike that sails to the middle of the goal, but his effort ends up in the goalkeeper's gloves.
51' Alejandro Garnacho (Chelsea) leaps high to meet a lofted pass near the penalty spot, but his header rattles the left post!

49' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the bottom right corner, but Djordje Petrovic thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
47' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) collects a pass on the edge of the box but he slips the ball just wide of the right post.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+5' Michael Oliver has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+5' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels low towards the middle of the target, but Robert Sanchez easily deals with the threat.
45+4' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) misses a big opportunity after striking the ball towards the middle of the goal and the goalkeeper makes an easy save.
45+3' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.

45' What a poor attempt! Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes into the stands.
43' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) cracks a shot goalwards from the edge of the box, but his radar is off and it sails well wide of the left post.
41' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) rushes a shot from long range and subsequently sends it high over the bar.
39' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Michael Oliver blows his whistle for a foul.
36' Evanilson (Bournemouth) misses a sitter from inside the six-yard box after striking the ball towards goal and it goes narrowly wide of the right post.
35' Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 7:4.
34' Bournemouth quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
33' Bournemouth have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
33' Marc Guiu (Chelsea) was too forceful with his tackle and Michael Oliver interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
32' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Liam Delap leaves the pitch to be replaced by Marc Guiu (Chelsea).
30' Liam Delap (Chelsea) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
29' Robert Sanchez comes off his line to intercept the corner from Alex Scott (Bournemouth).
29' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
27' Michael Oliver couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) and blew his whistle.
25' Liam Delap (Chelsea) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
23' 3:1 – the total goal attempt statistics.
22' The referee blows his whistle as Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) was too aggressive in his challenge.
21' Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) misses a good chance to score. A perfect cross into the box finds Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) who rises for a header, but he sends the ball well over the bar.
18' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
16' Evanilson (Bournemouth) makes a rough challenge and Michael Oliver blows his whistle for a foul.
15' Alejandro Jimenez (Bournemouth) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
14' Reece James (Chelsea) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Michael Oliver blows for a foul.
12' The ball is cleared after Alejandro Garnacho (Chelsea) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
9' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
7' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) is adjudged offside.
6' The goal by Bournemouth won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
5' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Bournemouth players aren’t happy.
4' Goal! Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) fires the rebound into the top left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:0.
2' Rough tackle by Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The first half has just begun.
Chelsea will kick-off.
Michael Oliver is the one to supervise the game today.
